name: LuLu
changes: Port outbound NE filter setup, pause/resume lifecycle and Apple command-line graylist; no upstream UI or branding.
Rewrite rule evaluation in independently tested Rust with explicit OpenNavo precedence, same-destination upsert, PID generation checks, bounded pauses and fail-open behavior.
Replace upstream XPC and persistence with audit-token authenticated JSON IPC and extension-owned state.
Use direct clang/Cargo build without upstream build scripts or LaunchServices registration.

2026-10-25: extend the Apple command-line graylist with nscurl, openssl, rsync, ftp, tftp, ldapsearch and git-remote-http(s); rank rules by destination specificity; let identity-less or late flows still meet destination rules and block lists.
